featured_reviews.name: raju
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unfortunately, the staying experience at this hostel has been far from satisfactory.

The food quality is below average, and the hostel uses sub-standard dairy products and ingredients for the students. However, when the owner’s family’s food is prepared, they use branded and high-quality products. What feels even more unfair is that the owner often takes food from the hostel kitchen for his own home and even sends it to his friends, while we, the paying students, are left with inferior meals.

The hygiene in the hostel is another major issue. The place is not well-maintained, and the rooms are sometimes not  mopped. As a result, cockroaches and lizards are common in the rooms. Many students fall sick frequently, but the owner shows little to no concern about this.

Additionally, the staff aunts and night warden are often rude and unprofessional. They shout frequently, creating a stressful environment for the students. Only Sunita Aunty is kind and nice to students.

Overall, I feel that the hostel management prioritises their own needs over the well-being of the students. I sincerely hope the owner takes feedback seriously and makes the necessary improvements for the health and comfort of everyone staying here.

featured_reviews.name: shruti sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Staying at WiSH has honestly been one of the best decisions during my college journey. Moving away from home was scary at first, but WiSH never made me feel alone. The environment here is very safe, positive, and homely, which makes it so comfortable for students.

The rooms are well-maintained, hygiene is properly taken care of, and the food genuinely feels homemade. It’s very rare to find a place where you feel both comfortable and cared for at the same time.

A special thank you to Shailee di and Aarti Ji for always supporting me throughout my journey at WiSH. Whether it was during difficult days, studies, health issues, or just emotional support, they were always there with understanding and care. Their warmth and guidance made this place feel more like family than just a hostel.

What I love most about WiSH is that every student is treated with genuine care and attention. It truly feels like a second home, and I will always be grateful for the memories, comfort, and support I received here.

featured_reviews.name: Upwork Ninja
featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter stayed at this PG for two years, and it was an exceptionally safe and secure experience. Having an all-female management team and staff provided immense comfort and peace of mind while being away from my child. Everything was incredibly well-managed, and the staff was always friendly.
Special thanks to Aarti Ji and Shailee for their amazing support!.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: s r
featured_reviews.review_text: Very safe and homely pgs. It was so comfortable I stayed here in the same room for all 3 years of my graduation. Also recommended to a few friends everyone loved it as well. They help you with all your little problems and the staff here is the best!

featured_reviews.name: Tanisha Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing place to stay .Had the best three years here. Great food, excellent facilities, and everything was always up to the mark. It truly felt like a home away from home. Grateful for all the memories made here

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Gada
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wish Students Accommodation has been a truly wonderful place to stay. The environment is safe, clean, and very comfortable for students, making it feel like a home away from home. The rooms are well-maintained, and the overall atmosphere is peaceful and positive.

A special mention to Saroj Di and Bharti Di for their constant support and care. Their contribution goes beyond just managing the accommodation — they genuinely look after everyone with motherly warmth. Whether it’s checking in on students, helping during difficult days, or simply being there to listen, they make everyone feel cared for and comfortable. Their presence creates a very homely and secure environment for all of us.

The friendly atmosphere, supportive management, and well-organized facilities make it easy to adjust and focus on studies while also enjoying hostel life. From small celebrations to everyday conversations, this place helps create beautiful memories.

Highly recommend Wish Students Accommodation to any student looking for a safe, caring, and comfortable place to stay. Thank you Saroj Di and Bharti Di for your unconditional support and for making this place feel like family. 💛

featured_reviews.name: Manju Pitty
featured_reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are great. They treat the children like their own too and the food tastes amazing and very yummy. The rooms are also really comfortable and spacious. Over all I'd like to say that the hostel feels a lot like home and my daughter loves her stay. Thank you so much Aarti Didi and Shailee Didi for always supporting my daughter and I.❤️🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Suchita Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter stayed in this PG for three years. It was extremely safe and secured. Everything was very well managed. The staff was very friendly, the food is also superb. Really recommended. To all parents just stop worrying and close your eyes and stay with them. Aarti ji and shailee are really gem of your owners.

featured_reviews.name: Vandita Banka
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m soo happy to be here. It’s genuinely a home here for me. Not just the pg but the owners too treat all of us like their own. Thank you for making my stay in Mumbai this safe and comfortable.
